notes:
Inbound SMB lead from support automation space. Product: RivetDesk - lightweight ticket triage + smart-summaries for small-mid support teams.
- Primary ask: hosted API (self-serve) to run POC. Focus on ticket summarization (short TL;DR), structured-output JSON mapping to Zendesk fields, and tool-calling to create/update tickets.
- Performance: wants sub-second perceptual latency for agent UX (p95 target ~500-800ms for short replies), throughput low (tens reqs/min), cost sensitive (small ARR).
- Model preferences: open / cost-efficient models ok (quantized variants desirable). Willing to start on smallest hosted tier and scale if latency/SLO met.
- Security: requires SSO/SAML, audit logs, and retention controls. Data residency not strict (NA primary). Asked about SOC2 roadmap — currently not required but would speed procurement if available.
- Quotes / paraphrase: 'We need something that Just Works out of the box — easy keys, JSON outputs we can map to our ticketing schema, and a predictable monthly bill.'
- Integration notes: uses Zendesk + internal triage microservice (TriageFlow). They want Redwood to call a webhook to create/update tickets (tool-calling demo).
- POC scope: 2-week trial using hosted API keys; 3 flows (summarize incoming email -> structured JSON, extract entities -> map to ticket fields, and tool-call to push to Zendesk).
- AE actions: send trial key + quickstart examples (structured-output templates, sample prompts, rate limits), share short checklist for SSO + audit log expectations, propose POC kickoff week of 2026-03-15.
- Risks: budget constraints, primary decision-maker (CTO) traveling until mid-April, potential ask for SOC2 in procurement which could delay purchase.
- Internal notes: good fit for hosted_api self-serve motion — likely convert if POC shows latency/cost wins and mapping to Zendesk is reliable.
